arxiv-2102-01679.creator: A. A. Fomin, M. Yu. Petrov, G. G. Kozlov, A. K. Vershovskii, M. M. Glazov, V. S. Zapasskii
arxiv-2102-01679.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by A. A. Fomin, M. Yu. Petrov, G. G. Kozlov, A. K. Vershovskii, M. M. Glazov, V. S. Zapasskii. We uncover a highly nontrivial dependence of the spin-noise (SN) resonance broadening induced by the intense probe beam. The measurements were performed by probing the cell with cesium vapor at the wavelengths of the transition 6 2 ​ S 1 / 2 ↔ 6 2 ​ P 3 / 2 {6}^{2}S_{1/2}\leftrightarrow{6}^{2}P_{3/2} ( D 2 \mathrm{D}_{2} line) with the unresolved hyperfine structure of the excited state.

arxiv-2105-11974.title: Change in the orbital period of a binary system due to an outburst in a windy accretion disc
arxiv-2105-11974.creator: A. L. Avakyan 1,2 , G. V. Lipunova, 1 , K. L. Malanchev 1,3 , N.I. Shakura 1,4 1 Lomonosov Moscow State University, Sternberg Astronomical Institute, Moscow, Russia 2 Lomonosov Moscow State University, Faculty of Physics, Moscow, Russia 3 University of Illinois at Urban–Champaign, Urbana, Illinois,
arxiv-2105-11974.description: Abstract We consider a new mechanism for the removal of the angular momentum from an X-ray binary system and the change in its orbital period — the mass loss in the form of a wind from an accretion disc. Both observations and models predict powerful winds from discs in X-ray transients.

arxiv-2402-11679.title: Adaptively Learning Memory Incorporating PSO
arxiv-2402-11679.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by . Dmytro Shchyrba, drumyraetherid@gmail.com [1]Izabela Aleksandra Paniczek[2]
Wroclaw University of Science and Technology, Wroclaw, Poland

1
Abstract

Selection of perefect parameters for low-pass filters can sometimes be an expensive problem with no analytical solution or differentiability of cost function. In this paper, we introduce a new PSO-inspired algorithm, that incorporates the positive experiences of the swarm to learn the geometry of the search space,thus obtaining the ability to consistently reach global optimum and is especially suitable for nonsmooth semiconvex functions optimization.

arxiv-2404-14937.description: Abstract For an oriented graph D D , the inversion of X ⊆ V ⁡ ( D ) X\subseteq V(D) in D D is the digraph obtained from D D by reversing the direction of all arcs with both ends in X X .

arxiv-2404-17899.title: Stability of the regular n n -gon rotating equilibria with logarithm interaction
arxiv-2404-17899.creator: Anna-Monika Muscaş Daniel Paşca Cristina Stoica
arxiv-2404-17899.description: Abstract Abstract We study the linear stability of regular n -gon rotating equilibria in the n -body problem with logarithm interaction. In the presence of a central mass M , linear stability is insured if M is bounded below and above by constants depending on the number and mass of the (equal) outer n bodies.

arxiv-2410-08922.title: Exploring the Design Space of Cognitive Engagement Techniques with AI-Generated Code for Enhanced Learning
arxiv-2410-08922.creator: Majeed Kazemitabaar, Oliver Huang, Sangho Suh, Austin Z. Henley, Tovi Grossman
arxiv-2410-08922.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Majeed Kazemitabaar, Oliver Huang, Sangho Suh, Austin Z. Henley, Tovi Grossman. Novice programmers are increasingly relying on Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate code for learning programming concepts. However, this interaction can lead to superficial engagement, giving learners an illusion of learning and hindering skill development. To address this issue, we conducted a systematic design exploration to develop seven cognitive engagement techniques aimed at promoting deeper engagement with AI-generated code.

arxiv-2506-19407.title: Quantum simulation of thermodynamics: Maxwell relations for pair correlations
arxiv-2506-19407.creator: F. Rist, R. S. Watson, H. L. Nourse, B. J. Powell, K. V. Kheruntsyan
arxiv-2506-19407.description: Abstract Quantum simulators hold enormous promise for advancing the modelling of materials and understanding emergent physics, such as high temperature superconductivity and topological order. While correlation functions are, typically, straightforward to measure in quantum simulators, thermodynamic properties are not. This limits our ability to directly compare the results of quantum simulations to experiments on the materials being modelled.

arxiv-2511-16723.title: A new suite of Lund-tree observables to resolve jets Preprint: CERN-TH-2025-213, Nikhef 2025-016
arxiv-2511-16723.creator: Melissa van Beekveld, Luca Buonocore, Silvia Ferrario Ravasio, Pier Francesco Monni, Alba Soto-Ontoso, Gregory Soyez
arxiv-2511-16723.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Melissa van Beekveld, Luca Buonocore, Silvia Ferrario Ravasio, Pier Francesco Monni, Alba Soto-Ontoso, Gregory Soyez. We introduce a class of collider observables, named Lund-Tree Shapes (LTS), defined from declustering trees originating from the Lund jet plane representation of the QCD radiation pattern in multi-jet scattering processes. At the differential level, they are continuous global variables akin classical event shapes and n → n + 1 n\to n+1 jet-resolution parameters, which probe the geometry and hierarchical structure of the radiation in an event.

arxiv-2512-21713.title: Investigation of quantum chaos in local and non-local Ising models
arxiv-2512-21713.creator: Reza Pirmoradian, Elham Sadoogh, Maryam Teymouri, Negar Abolqasemi-Azad, Mohammad Reza Lahooti, Zahra Mohammad-Ali
arxiv-2512-21713.description: Abstract We investigate signatures of quantum chaos within Ising spin chains subjected to transverse and longitudinal fields, incorporating both local (nearest-neighbor) and non-local (long-range) couplings. While local Ising models may exhibit integrable or chaotic dynamics contingent on interaction strengths and field parameters, systems with non-local interactions generally display a stronger propensity toward chaos, even when the non-local couplings are weak.

arxiv-2601-05679.title: Falsifying Sparse Autoencoder Reasoning Features in Language Models
arxiv-2601-05679.creator: George Ma, Zhongyuan Liang, Irene Y. Chen, Somayeh Sojoudi
arxiv-2601-05679.description: Abstract We study how reliably sparse autoencoders (SAEs) support claims about reasoning-related internal features in large language models. We first give a stylized analysis showing that sparsity-regularized decoding can preferentially retain stable low-dimensional correlates while suppressing high-dimensional within-behavior variation, motivating the possibility that contrastively selected “reasoning” features may concentrate on cue-like structure when such cues are coupled with reasoning traces.

The service has attracted attention from experimental psychologists interested in gathering human subject data more efficiently....

pmc-10506670.title: Predictive Models of Muscle Strength in Older People with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
pmc-10506670.creator: Mateus Medeiros Leite, Ivo Vieira de Sousa Neto, Maurílio Tiradentes Dutra, Silvana Schwerz Funghetto, Alessandro de Oliveira Silva, Izabel Cristina Rodrigues da Silva, Luciano Ramos de Lima, Marina Morato Stival
pmc-10506670.description: PurposeTo propose predictive models for absolute muscle strength (AMS) of elderly people with type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (DM2) in primary health care.Patients and MethodsThe cross-sectional study was conducted with 138 elderly diabetics. The AMS was measured by a JAMAR® hydraulic handgrip dynamometer, determined by the sum of both hands.

pmc-11409398.title: Clinical effectiveness of robotic versus laparoscopic and open surgery: an overview of systematic reviews
pmc-11409398.creator: Tzu-Jung Lai, Campbell Roxburgh, Kathleen Anne Boyd, Janet Bouttell
pmc-11409398.description: ObjectiveTo undertake a review of systematic reviews on the clinical outcomes of robotic-assisted surgery across a mix of intracavity procedures, using evidence mapping to inform the decision makers on the best utilisation of robotic-assisted surgery.Eligibility criteriaWe included systematic reviews with randomised controlled trials and non-randomised controlled trials describing any clinical outcomes.

pmc-11859939.creator: E González Laynez, B Gamo Bravo, S M Bañón González, N Ogando Portilla
pmc-11859939.description: IntroductionADHD is a diagnosis almost always made in childhood or adolescence and oftent difficult to make it new in adults because it is not thought of in the differential diagnosis process and for the lack of experience from adult devices. ADHD in adults is characterized by symptoms of executive dysfunction, inattention, emotional dysregulation.

pmc-12368043.title: Neural contrast sensitivity is not affected by myopic blur
pmc-12368043.creator: Niklas Domdei, Jonas Müller, Lisa Renner, Julius Ameln, Katharina Breher, Wolf Harmening, Siegfried Wahl
pmc-12368043.description: The prevalence of myopia is increasing worldwide, accompanied by an increase of potentially under-corrected myopes. Because neural pathways are prone to adaptation in relation to the sensory input, we wondered to what extent neural contrast sensitivity (NCS) is altered in the presence of image blur arising from under-correction.

pmc-12654854.title: Phytochemical Characterisation and Antioxidant and Anti-Inflammatory Potential of Muscari neglectum (Asparagaceae) Bulbs
pmc-12654854.creator: María del Carmen Villegas-Aguilar, Antonio Segura-Carretero, Víctor N Suárez-Santiago, Cristina Forzato
pmc-12654854.description: Muscari neglectum is a Mediterranean geophyte with a long tradition of ethnomedicinal use, yet the phytochemistry of its bulbs remains underexplored compared with aerial parts. This study aimed to characterise the metabolite profile of M. neglectum bulbs and to assess their antioxidant and radical scavenging potential, and anti-inflammatory potential.

pmc-12708012.title: Trends in Sleep Disturbances Among Older Adults: A Secondary Analysis of the National Health Interview Survey (NHIS)
pmc-12708012.creator: Arjun Mahesh, Anjali Rajpoot
pmc-12708012.description: Background: Sleep disturbances are very common in older adults, and their effects can affect cognition and physical health, and also reduce quality of life. It has been reported in past research that inadequate or low-quality sleep is linked to cardiovascular disease and depression, as well as a higher risk of death in late life.

pmc-12750567.title: Submandibular infection in a healthy child caused by Legionella maceachernii
pmc-12750567.creator: Xiaoyun Ye, Ji-An Li, Shifu Wang, Shengwei Luan, Jie Zheng, Shichun Lv, Guoqing Zheng, Wenwen Jiang, Xinrui Huang, Jingjing Xu, Lingdong Zhu, Beibei Niu
pmc-12750567.description: Extra-pulmonary infections caused by Legionella maceachernii are exceptionally rare, particularly in immunocompetent children. This case report describes a young child with a submandibular infection caused by L. maceachernii, who achieved complete recovery following combination therapy with azithromycin and sulfamethoxazole-trimethoprim (SMZ-TMP).

pmc-12860059.title: Wastewater surveillance of rotavirus, norovirus, and hepatitis a virus in the Middle East and North Africa Region: a systematic review
pmc-12860059.creator: Mariam Mroweh, Laura Hergelian, Bassel Serrieh, Aya Youssef, Maria Santana-Garces, Kyle Crooker, Marcus Zervos, Paul Kilgore, Nada M. Melhem
pmc-12860059.description: BackgroundWastewater surveillance (WWS) is a valuable tool for monitoring circulating and emerging pathogens, and emerging variants, providing an early warning system for potential epidemics. Its use for key viral diarrheal pathogens like Rotavirus (RV), Norovirus (NoV), and Hepatitis A Virus (HAV) remains underexplored in the Middle East and North African (MENA) region.

pmc-13197323.title: Open habitats and species differences shape space use in semi-feral cattle and horses across Danish rewilding sites
pmc-13197323.creator: Marianne Damholdt Bergin, Luca Börger, Érika Garcez da Rocha, Rasmus Worsøe Havmøller, Mads Jensen, Jens-Christian Svenning
pmc-13197323.description: Large herbivores can strongly influence ecosystem structure and biodiversity, making knowledge of their space use important for trophic rewilding. We used GPS-tracking data collected over two years from 10 semi-feral cattle and 17 horses across ten Danish rewilding sites to analyse habitat use in a use–availability framework using resource selection functions (RSFs), complemented by direct behavioural observations.

pmc-13563953.title: Prevalence and characteristics of persistent symptoms following hospitalization for COVID-19: a cross-sectional follow-up study
pmc-13563953.creator: Huseyin Dogus Okan, Gulsum Kaya
pmc-13563953.description: BackgroundAlthough coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) primarily presents as an acute respiratory infection, many patients continue to experience symptoms after the acute phase of the disease. Early persistent symptoms during the post-acute recovery period may adversely affect functional recovery and quality of life. This study aimed to evaluate persistent symptoms in hospitalized COVID-19 patients following completion of the quarantine period.

pmc-13573299.title: Prognostic Value of the Prognostic Nutritional Index in Patients with Metastatic Melanoma
pmc-13573299.creator: Mustafa Sahbazlar, Hikmet Akar, Atike Pinar Erdogan, Ferhat Ekinci
pmc-13573299.description: BackgroundPrognostic outcomes vary considerably among patients with metastatic melanoma. We examined the association of the prognostic nutritional index (PNI), neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), and systemic immune-inflammation index (SII) with overall survival in this patient population.MethodsWe retrospectively evaluated 60 patients with metastatic melanoma treated at a single center. PNI was derived from serum albumin and absolute lymphocyte count.

pmc-13678879.title: Aqueous extract of erigeron annuus ameliorates OVA-induced atopic dermatitis-like skin lesions through modulation of Th2-mediated immune responses and MAPK signaling
pmc-13678879.creator: Yejin Ahn, Min Ji Gu, Ho-Young Park, Seol Ji Baek, Seong Un Jeong, Sang Keun Ha, Donghwan Kim
pmc-13678879.description: ContextAtopic dermatitis is a chronic inflammatory skin disorder characterized by epidermal barrier dysfunction and dysregulated type 2 helper T cell (Th2)-mediated immune responses. Erigeron annuus (L.) Desf. is traditionally used for inflammatory conditions, but its effects on atopic dermatitis remain unclear.ObjectiveThis study evaluated the protective effects of E. annuus aqueous extract (EA) and associated mechanisms.
